description: Playlist review candidates: reference parsing, page normalization, review issues and promotion to a card (contract/playlist-candidates.md). Fictional titles, artists and made-up well-formed IDs only. references: input text and the playlist reference or null. pages: provider, the number of entries already received (start), the Apple storefront when given, the raw page (or `json`, the exact page text, which `decodePlaylistPage` reads from its UTF-8 bytes first and which must be rejected with {error: true} when decoding fails) and either {candidates, next} or {error: true} when the page is rejected. decks: named decks that review and promotion cases refer to by name. review: candidates and a deck name, with one expected entry per candidate. promotion: a deck name, a candidate (`schemaInvalid: true` marks one that deliberately breaks candidate-v1.schema.json) and a decision, with the appended card and the resulting card count or an error name.
